blocks.text: Zoning, Land Use & Site Checks in Central Abbotsford

parts.t: Central Abbotsford is covered by three major City of Abbotsford neighbourhood plans: the City Centre Neighbourhood Plan (high- and mid-rise mixed-use density along South Fraser Way and Gladwin Road), the Historic Downtown Neighbourhood Plan (commercial-residential infill around Essendene and Montrose), and the UDistrict Neighbourhood Plan (housing and commercial density around UFV, King Road, and McCallum Road). Detached lots inside urban infill areas also qualify for small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) or garden suites subject to servicing.

Before submitting an offer on any property in Central Abbotsford, we verify the parcel's current zone under City of Abbotsford Zoning Bylaw No. 2400-2014, its Official Community Plan (OCP) land use designation, BC Land Title Office charges and Section 219 covenants, building permit history at City Hall (32315 South Fraser Way), and—where applicable—Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) rules or strata depreciation reports.
